order.description: Every site slug in landing-page order, inactive sites included.

rootSite.description: Where `/` on the hub redirects; must be an active site. Absent: `/` serves the PepTalk landing page and `/all` answers 301 to `/`; set: the landing page stays at `/all`.

redirects.description: Old slug -> new slug; pages and Open Graph cards answer 301.

indexable.description: Hub pages (the landing page, `/terms`, `/privacy`) may be indexed. Previews never index.

domains.description: Per-site domains, keyed by a slug in `order` (docs/domains.md). A site with a domain is also served at the root of its own host; each host belongs to one site and never the hub’s host. Unpublished sites’ domains are ignored.

primary.description: The canonical host: lowercase, no scheme, port, path or trailing dot.

aliases.description: Extra hosts that answer 301 to `primary`, keeping path and query. `[]` for none.

live.description: `true` once DNS and TLS work: the hub folder answers 301 to the domain, and canonical URLs use it.
